sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: Tiger-Elk: A large striped elk-predator with branching antlers and catlike shoulders, glimpsed at a distance before the forest remembers how quiet it can be.

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: A large striped elk-predator with branching antlers and catlike shoulders, glimpsed at a distance before the forest remembers how quiet it can be.

sections.title: GM truth
sections.body: No forced reveal. Let this entity disclose truth through scene context and player attention.

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use as a moral encounter. Reward restraint and observation without forcing a pet or mascot outcome.
